questions.stem: 在刺青（tattoo）之前，許多人會花數個月挑選圖案，這顯示刺青不再只是叛逆的象徵。
questions.answer: Before getting a tattoo, many people spend months choosing the design, which shows that tattoos are no longer merely a symbol of rebellion.
accepted_answers: Before getting tattooed, many people spend several months picking a design, which shows that tattoos are no longer only a sign of rebellion.
Before having a tattoo done, many people spend a few months selecting the pattern, which indicates that tattoos are no longer simply a symbol of rebellion.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which shows that …）

questions.stem: 相較於上一代，現在的年輕人更在乎刺青（tattoo）代表什麼，而不是別人怎麼看待它。
questions.answer: Compared with the previous generation, young people today care more about what a tattoo represents than about how others see it.
accepted_answers: Compared to the older generation, today's young people care more about what their tattoos represent than how other people view them.
Compared with their parents' generation, young people nowadays care more about what tattoos stand for than about what others think of them.

patterns: 間接問句（what a tattoo means）

1.explanation_zh: 「在刺青之前」主詞和後面的「許多人」相同，用 Before getting a tattoo（before 後接動名詞）。「花數個月挑選圖案」是 spend months choosing the design（spend + 時間 + V-ing）。「這顯示…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which shows that …。「不再只是叛逆的象徵」寫 are no longer just a symbol of rebellion，「叛逆」用抽象名詞 rebellion。
evidence: 這顯示刺青不再只是叛逆的象徵
1.strategy_zh: 「在…之前／時／之後」主詞相同時，用 Before／When／After + V-ing；「…，這顯示…」用 , which shows that …。
hints: 切成四段：在刺青（tattoo）之前／許多人會花數個月挑選圖案／這顯示／刺青不再只是叛逆的象徵
標的詞彙：spend（花時間）、month（月）、choose（挑選）、design（圖案）、show（顯示）、no longer（不再）、symbol（象徵）、rebellion（叛逆）
句型框架：Before + V-ing …, S + spend + 時間 + V-ing …, which shows that + S + are no longer …

2.explanation_zh: 「相較於上一代」用 Compared with the previous generation（過去分詞片語，不寫 Compare／Comparing）。「更在乎…而不是…」用比較結構 care more about A than (about) B。A、B 都是放在句子裡的問句：「刺青代表什麼」what a tattoo means、「別人怎麼看待它」how others see it，間接問句一律用直述句語序，不用 does 倒裝；「別人」是 others。
2.strategy_zh: 句子裡出現「什麼、怎麼、是否」的問句當受詞時，改成間接問句（wh- + 主詞 + 動詞）；「相較於…」用 Compared with + N。
hints: 切成四段：相較於上一代／現在的年輕人更在乎／刺青（tattoo）代表什麼／而不是別人怎麼看待它
標的詞彙：compare（相較）、generation（世代）、young（年輕的）、care（在乎）、mean（代表）、other（別人）、see（看待）
句型框架：Compared with + N, S + care more about + what + S + V + than (about) + how + S + V.

bonus.text: Before getting inked, many people now spend months choosing a design, proof that tattoos have outgrown their image as a symbol of rebellion.
bonus.explanation_zh: get inked（刺青，口語）、句尾同位語 proof that …（證明…）、outgrow（擺脫、超越原本的形象）是進階寫法；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「在刺青之前」主詞和後面的「許多人」相同，用連接詞＋分詞 Before getting a tattoo；「這顯示…」指前面整件事，用 , which shows that …，不能用逗號直接接 it shows。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：「在刺青之前」Before getting a tattoo（getting tattooed、having a tattoo done 也可以），寫成完整子句 Before they get a tattoo 也算達成本句 PART 標的（連接詞＋分詞就是省略主詞的副詞子句）；「花數個月挑選圖案」spend (several／a few) months choosing／picking／selecting the (a) design（pattern），take months to choose … 也可以；「這顯示」, which shows／indicates／suggests (that) …，寫成句尾分詞 , showing that … 也算達成本句 NRREL 標的；「刺青不再只是叛逆的象徵」tattoos are no longer just／only／simply／merely a symbol／sign of rebellion（not … anymore 也可以）。另外也給分：many people will／would spend …、many people take (several) months to choose (pick／select) the design。

traps.literal_error: Compared with the previous generation, now young people care more about …
traps.explanation_zh: 「現在的」修飾「年輕人」，英文寫 young people today 或 today's young people；副詞 now 不能直接放在名詞前。

bonus.text: Unlike their parents' generation, young people today are far more interested in what a tattoo says about them than in how others might judge it.
bonus.explanation_zh: what a tattoo says about them（刺青透露了自己什麼）、how others might judge it（別人可能怎麼評斷）讓語意更細緻；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「刺青代表什麼」「別人怎麼看待它」都是放在句子裡的問句，英文改成間接問句 what a tattoo means／how others see it（直述句語序）；「相較於上一代」用 Compared with …，比較結果寫 care more about … than …。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：「相較於上一代」Compared with／to (In comparison with) the previous (older) generation、their parents' generation、older generations，寫 Unlike the previous generation 也可以（比較的意思由 care more … than … 表達，仍算達成本句 COMP 標的）；「現在的年輕人更在乎」young people today／today's young people／young people nowadays + care more about（are more concerned about／with、pay more attention to、focus more on）；「刺青代表什麼」what a tattoo (their tattoos) means／represents／stands for／symbolizes；「而不是別人怎麼看待它」than (about)／rather than／instead of + how others (other people) see／view it (them)、what others think of it (them)。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.1: 首選參考譯文有詞彙表外的字 ['tattoos']（表外專有名詞請在題目括號附英文）

1.translation: Before getting a tattoo, many people spend several months choosing a design, which shows that tattoos are no longer just a symbol of rebellion.
1.explanation_zh: 「在刺青之前」用 Before getting a tattoo；「花數個月挑選」用 spend + 時間 + V-ing；「這顯示」用非限定關係子句 , which shows that；「不再只是」用 no longer just。

2.translation: Compared with the previous generation, young people today care more about what a tattoo represents than about how other people view it.
2.explanation_zh: 「相較於上一代」用 Compared with；「更在乎 A 而不是 B」用 care more about A than about B；A、B 都是間接問句 what a tattoo represents／how other people view it。中文同時有兩組比較（上一代 vs. 現在；代表什麼 vs. 別人看法），英文照順序排列，語意仍清楚，但結構略重，信心給 medium。

1.translation: Before getting a tattoo, many people spend months choosing a design, which shows that tattoos are no longer just a symbol of rebellion.
1.explanation_zh: 「在刺青之前」用 Before getting a tattoo（before 後接動名詞）；「花數個月挑選圖案」用 spend months choosing a design；「這顯示……」用非限定關係子句 which shows that ...；「不再只是」為 no longer just。

2.translation: Compared with the previous generation, young people today care more about what a tattoo stands for than about what others think of it.
2.explanation_zh: 「相較於上一代」用 Compared with the previous generation；「更在乎……而不是……」用 care more about A than about B，A 是名詞子句 what a tattoo stands for，B 是 what others think of it（「別人怎麼看待它」）。
